speaker: Patient
text: The pain feels like a tight band squeezing my chest and often shoots down into my jaw and left arm. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Unstable Angina or NSTEMI). Given the classic presentation of exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw and arm accompanied by diaphoresis and dyspnea, immediate cardiac intervention is required.
